turns.replyTail:
helpful details:

Exchanges are always free, return shipping is included
The exchange portal is for the same style in a different size, inseam, or color

They can drop the return off at FedEx, USPS, or an approved Walgreens location

Also, our standard shipments do not include a packing slip with prices, which is nice for gifting. Let me know if there’s anything more I can assist with.

turns.replyText:
Any discount if I add a second smaller item?

They can exchange it through the SPANX returns portal once they have the order number and the email used at checkout.

How it works:

Go to our returns and exchanges page: Start a Return or Exchange
Enter the order number, making sure it starts with 0
Select the item and choose exchange
Pick the new size, inseam, or color for the same style

A few helpful details:

Exchanges are always free, return shipping is included
The exchange portal is for the same style in a different size, inseam, or color
If they want a completely different style, they would return it and place a new order instead
They can drop the return off at FedEx, USPS, or an approved Walgreens location

Also, our standard shipments do not include a packing slip with prices, which is nice for gifting. Let me know if there’s anything more I can assist with.
